title: myocarditis 1
characteristics_ch1: subject status: patients with therapy-associated cardiac injury
treatment_protocol_ch1: The cohort comprised patients with anti-PD-1 antibody therapy-associated cardiac injury (diagnosed as “possible myocarditis”; n = 4), and control patients without signs of cardiac injury after anti-PD-1 antibody therapies (n = 3).
extract_protocol_ch1: Venous blood (2 mL) was collected in EDTA anticoagulant tubes and processed within 4 h. Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) were isolated by density gradient centrifugation using Ficoll-Paque medium. Cell viability exceeded 85%, determined by trypan blue staining. Approximately 15,000 cells per sample were prepared for downstream capture.

Libraries were constructed using the Chromium Single Cell V(D)J 5' Reagent V2 Kit (10x Genomics). For each sample, 15,000 cells were loaded for gel bead-in-emulsion (GEM) generation. Released RNA was barcoded through reverse transcription. cDNA was amplified and library quality was assessed via Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer. Paired-end sequencing (2 × 150 bp) was performed on an Illumina NovaSeq platform (Novogene).
data_processing: Raw data were processed using Cell Ranger software v5.0.0 (10x Genomics) for alignment to the human reference genome (GRCh38/hg38) and transcript quantification.
Assembly: Homo sapiens (GRCh38/hg38)
Supplementary files format and content: Filtered gene-barcode expression matrices in HDF5 (.h5) formats.
